title: The Lake That Turns Pink
short_teaser: Some lakes become pink because of microorganisms and high salt conditions.
story: Some lakes become pink because of microorganisms and high salt conditions. Color can be evidence of an entire hidden ecosystem. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective by reminding us how much remains unseen. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Color can be evidence of an entire hidden ecosystem. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective by reminding us how much remains unseen.
spark_application: Spend five quiet minutes noticing something that creates awe or surprise. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
